round1.reason: acceptance-bound policy requires explicit depth-0 authority for every non-exact finding

seats.findings:
🟠 [bulk-threshold] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 uses `qty > 10`, so qty 10 gets no bulk discount although the contract says "10 or more"; change to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [cap-half-ceil] MUST-FIX src/cap.js:4 caps at `Math.ceil(subtotal / 2) + 1`, allowing discounts above 50 percent (e.g. subtotal 100 allows 51); change to `Math.min(discount, Math.floor(subtotal / 2))`
🟠 [clamp-upper] MUST-FIX src/clamp.js:5 clamps to 98, so clampQty(99) returns 98 against the 1..99 inclusive range; change the upper bound to 99
🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so every coupon is one tenth of the contracted discount and checkoutTotal inherits the error; change to `/ 100`
🟠 [fee-fixed] MUST-FIX src/fee.js:4 adds 3 cents instead of the contracted fixed 30 cents; change `+ 3` to `+ 30`
🟠 [loyalty-round] MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js:4 uses Math.round, so 150 cents yields 2 points instead of 1 (one point per full 100 cents); change to `Math.floor(cents / 100)`
🟠 [minimum-strict] MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:4 uses `cents > 1000`, so an order of exactly 1000 cents is rejected although "at least 1000" must pass; change to `>=`
🟠 [refund-fee-floor] MUST-FIX src/refund.js:4 uses Math.min(100, fee), making the fee at most 100 instead of at least 100 (e.g. 10000 paid refunds 9900 instead of 9500); change to `Math.max(100, ...)`
🟠 [ship-started-block] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:6 uses Math.floor on the extra weight, so 1001 g costs 500 instead of 600 (each started additional 500 g must be charged); change to `Math.ceil(extra / 500)`
🟠 [split-remainder] MUST-FIX src/split.js:6 uses `i <= rem`, giving rem+1 shares an extra cent so the shares no longer sum to total (splitCents(10, 3) returns [4,4,3] = 11); change to `i < rem`
🟠 [tax-divisor] MUST-FIX src/tax.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 10000, producing ten times the contracted tax and corrupting checkoutTotal and invoiceLine; change to `/ 10000`

🟠 [coupon-div-1000] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so every coupon discount is 10x too small (e.g. subtotal=10000, pct=10 → 100 instead of 1000); also propagates into checkoutTotal — change the divisor to 100
🟠 [tax-div-1000] MUST-FIX src/tax.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 10000, so tax is 10x too large (e.g. amount=1000, rateBp=1000 → 1000 instead of 100); also propagates into checkoutTotal and invoiceLine — change the divisor to 10000
🟠 [split-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/split.js:6 uses `i <= rem` so rem+1 shares each get an extra cent and the array sums to total+1 (total=10, n=3 → [4,4,3]=11; even rem=0 mis-sums to total+1); shares must sum exactly to total — change to `i < rem`
🟠 [bulk-threshold] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 applies the 10% discount only when `qty > 10`, but the contract says qty 10 or more; a 10-item line is charged full price — change to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [clamp-max-98] MUST-FIX src/clamp.js:5 clamps to 98 via `Math.min(98, ...)`, so clampQty(99) returns 98 outside the required 1..99 range — change 98 to 99
🟠 [cap-over-50pct] MUST-FIX src/cap.js:4 caps at `Math.ceil(subtotal / 2) + 1` instead of `Math.floor(subtotal / 2)` (subtotal=100 → cap 51 instead of 50), letting discounts exceed the 50% limit and rounding the wrong way — use `Math.min(discount, Math.floor(subtotal / 2))`
🟠 [fee-fixed-3] MUST-FIX src/fee.js:4 adds a fixed 3 cents instead of 30 (cardFeeCents(1000) → 32 instead of 59); change the constant to 30
🟠 [loyalty-round-not-floor] MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js:4 uses Math.round instead of rounding down, so pointsFor(150) returns 2 instead of 1 point per full 100 cents — use `Math.floor(cents / 100)`
🟠 [minorder-strict-gt] MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:4 uses `cents > 1000`, rejecting an order of exactly 1000 cents that meets the minimum — change to `cents >= 1000`
🟠 [refund-fee-minmax] MUST-FIX src/refund.js:4 computes the fee as `Math.min(100, ...)` (at most 100) instead of `Math.max(100, Math.round(paidCents * 0.05))` (at least 100); paid=10000 refunds 9900 instead of 9500 — change Math.min to Math.max
🟠 [ship-floor-vs-ceil] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:6 uses `Math.floor(extra / 500)`, ignoring started-but-unfinished 500 g blocks: 1001 g returns 500 instead of 600 ("each started additional 500 g"); use `Math.ceil(extra / 500) * 100`

🟠 [bulk-threshold] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:4 uses `qty > 10` but spec requires the discount at qty 10 or more; change to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [cap-formula] MUST-FIX src/cap.js:4 computes `Math.ceil(subtotal / 2) + 1` but spec requires at most 50% rounded down; replace with `Math.floor(subtotal / 2)`
🟠 [clamp-upper] MUST-FIX src/clamp.js:4 caps at 98 via `Math.min(98, …)` but spec says range 1..99 inclusive; change to `Math.min(99, …)`
🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 100, producing a discount ten times too small; change `/ 1000` to `/ 100`
🟠 [fee-fixed] MUST-FIX src/fee.js:4 adds 3 instead of the specified fixed 30 cents; change `+ 3` to `+ 30`
🟠 [invoice-format] MUST-FIX src/invoice.js:5 returns the numeric sum `amount + tax` but spec format is "label: amount+tax" showing both values; change to `` `${label}: ${amount}+${taxCents(amount, rateBp)}` ``
🟠 [loyalty-round] MUST-FIX src/loyalty.js:4 uses `Math.round` but spec requires floor (one point per full 100 cents); change to `Math.floor`
🟠 [minorder-boundary] MUST-FIX src/minorder.js:4 uses `cents > 1000` but spec says "at least 1000"; change to `cents >= 1000`
🟠 [refund-logic] MUST-FIX src/refund.js:4 caps the fee at 100 instead of ensuring the refund is at least 100; correct logic: `const fee = Math.round(paidCents * 0.05); return Math.max(100, paidCents - fee);` (the never-below-0 clause is subsumed by the 100-cent floor)
🟠 [ship-ceil] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:5 uses `Math.floor(extra / 500)` but "each started additional 500 g" requires ceiling; change to `Math.ceil(extra / 500)`
🟠 [split-remainder] MUST-FIX src/split.js:5 uses `i <= rem` which gives rem+1 shares an extra cent, breaking the exact-sum invariant; change to `i < rem`
🟠 [tax-divisor] MUST-FIX src/tax.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 10000, inflating tax tenfold; change `/ 1000` to `/ 10000`
